mapper.select: SELECT id, name, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time FROM sms_seckill_activity WHERE status <> 2 AND end_time > #{now} AND start_time <= DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL #{aheadMinutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY start_time LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, name, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time FROM sms_seckill_activity WHERE status <> 2 AND end_time > #{now} ORDER BY start_time
